proposition: The Munshaʾāt-i Yazdī contains seven items concerning Ibn Turka or the Turka family (eight in MS Sinā 316); they show Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī's attendance at his teacher's majlises, his accompanying him to Herat and his care for Ibn Turka's children after his death.

mediation.who: Compilers of the Yazdī collection (attribution to Qivām al-Dīn is confused)
mediation.where: MSS Vahid Paşa 621, Sinā 316, Cambridge H.5
mediation.note: The colophon of MS Sinā 316 gives 849/1445, after Qivām al-Dīn's death.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, summarising, dating and identifying the letter(s)
